purpose: Read-only verification of the published combined source against the qualified incoming Office merge and frozen Mail checkpoint.
comparison_method: Exact Git object ID, object type and mode comparison; union of old/new paths catches additions and deletions. Equal blob IDs establish byte identity.

incoming_product.selector: Every changed tracked file under packages/ or apps/, including source, tests, fixtures, tooling and rendering goldens.

mail_packages.selector: Complete tracked trees of every packages/quds_mail_* package, including product source, tests, fixtures, manifests and package documentation.

mail_studio_host_tests_and_tool.selector: Every tracked Studio example filename containing mail, including saved-mail hosts, native/cloud/web hosts, tests, support helpers and the web entry tool.

limitations: This is source and ancestry preservation evidence, not a new runtime test run.
Shared incoming Office dependencies changed; unchanged Mail source identity does not replace the separately running combined-source Studio qualification.
Remote ref confirmation records the captured instant and does not lock subsequent publications.
